decision: held: Dr. Pham's fourth ruling keeps this clinical record's specific missing acceptance as a governance dependency (liver-safety warnings are already implemented through the safety owner, so safety is no longer the blocker). Sources retried: 38031409 full text now retrieved (Cambridge open copy listed by OpenAlex) but not yet re-extracted into the pending context; 19597519 has only a bot-protected publisher copy. Any decision must keep brewed tea and concentrated extract separate.
summary: 38031409 abstract: 59 RCTs, 3802 participants; green tea extract reduced body mass, BMI, body-fat percentage and MDA and raised adiponectin and TAC, with no effect on fat mass, leptin or ghrelin (certainty low to high). 19597519 abstract: 11 studies; catechins reduced or maintained body weight by about -1.31 kg, moderated by caffeine intake and ethnicity. Effects are small; safety and dose verification remain open.

identity.preparation: Heterogeneous green-tea preparations: caffeinated/decaffeinated extracts,isolatedEGCG,tea powder and mixtures; extract mass is not catechin or EGCG mass.

population.description: 59 study reports/3802 adults; healthy,overweight/obese and clinical subgroups;5crossover and54parallel reports.

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials; synthesis-level outcomes do not establish every preparation or product.

outcomes.name: Pooled body mass,BMI,body-fat percentage and selected oxidative markers improved; fat mass,leptin and ghrelin did not.

limitations: Outcome-specific certainty rangedlow–high; repeated reports may sharetrialfamilies. No cancer,CVD,liver-treatment or universal weight-loss claim follows.
Eligibility text says duration>2weeks; Table1/body include2week studies. No cutoff repair invented. Physical capsule/tablet forms are not established for every extract by Table1.

47included PMID mappings independently verified;12source citations retain exact bibliographic identity without inventedPMIDs. PMID19176733 has a historicalerratum whose complete content is not established by this extraction.
Known product preparation,EGCG/caffeine composition,population and purpose still require exact correspondence; no new efficacy grade or approval.

dose.administration_frequency: Source Table1/body reports60–3000mg/day GTE over2–48weeks; trial-specific regimens and background interventions are not interchangeable.
co_therapies: Diet and exercise protocols varied; Table1 includes matched training/diet cointerventions and caffeine-containing preparations.
